plain: A person who keeps stirring up lawsuits and quarrels.

webster.text: One who frequently excites suits at law; a common mover and maintainer of suits and controversies; an encourager of litigation.

example.quote: If any man shall be proved and Judged a commen Barrator vexing others with unjust frequent and endlesse suites, It shall be in the power of Courts both to denie him the benefit of the law, and to punish him for his Barratry.
